queens.drag_aesthetic: Techno-rococo witchcraft: molten chrome corsets, vellum lace, rune-etched gloves, holographic tulle, cathedral veils, circuit filigree, meteor eyeliner, sanctified sparkle, storm siren hair, midnight opulence.
queens.performance_specialty: Storytelling lip-sync sorcery, precision reveals, spellbinding vogue dips, and mic-drop sermons.
queens.fatal_flaw: Spins grand narratives so big she risks losing the heartbeat of the moment.
queens.werkroom_entrance_line: Fear not, darlings—Gloria Hex Machina came with miracles, motherboards, and a money shot.

queens.drag_aesthetic: Electro-Victorian glam: luminous corsets, LED lace, iridescent smoke makeup, sculpted wigs with neon filigree and clockwork accessories
queens.performance_specialty: High-energy electro-pop lip syncs with theatrical illusion and precise voguing
queens.fatal_flaw: Perfectionism that snowballs into late-night breakdowns and overcomplicated numbers
queens.personal_catchphrase: Darling, I sparkle like a scandal and sting like a neon rose!
queens.werkroom_entrance_line: Ladies and gentlemen, make way for Countess Neon Lace—polished, prickly, and brighter than your electric dreams!

queens.drag_aesthetic: Chromatic futurism meets ballroom nostalgia. Iridescent lashes, chrome corset, cybernetic sleeves, holographic sequins that shift with the crowd. Velvet smoke, electric heartbeat, and neon whispers.
queens.performance_specialty: Fierce lip-sync, precision voguing, shimmering storytelling through chrome-edged choreography.
queens.fatal_flaw: Overthinks the runway, overprepares props, risks flashback moments and stumbles if tempo slips.
queens.personal_catchphrase: Glitz with grit, darling—read the room, serve the truth.
queens.werkroom_entrance_line: I am Neon Velvet Siren, streaming chrome dreams through velvet night—watch me bend light and break the stage.

queens.drag_aesthetic: Gothic cyber-baroque siren; neon latex, embroidered circuits, cathedral silhouettes, chrome tears, and velvet opera gloves, blending Renaissance drama with nightclub futurism to seduce and short-circuit.
queens.performance_specialty: Lip-sync storytelling with live glitch vocals, violin loops, and precision high-fashion reveals.
queens.fatal_flaw: Over-engineers every moment; perfectionism delays decisions, and she rewrites the number until the stage manager screams.
queens.personal_catchphrase: If you can't clock it, you can't stop Ophelia Overclock.
queens.werkroom_entrance_line: Blessed be the circuits, sinners; Ophelia Overclock has logged in to absolve your fashions, reboot your edges, and crash this competition.
